blurb: What truly sets this Afternoon Half-day, Carmel Valley Wine Tasting Tour apart is the unparalleled expertise of your guide, who not only boasts over 25 years of hands-on experience in the region but also holds a Master's Degree in Viticulture. This isn't just a tasting; it's an immersive educational journey!
